question: Which of the following is false regarding cooking?

options.text: resulting in loss of some nutrients

solution:
The correct answer is __**Destroys Vitamin D easily**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cooking generally **makes digestion easier** by breaking down complex food substances.
 
• It can **result in the loss of some nutrients**, especially water-soluble vitamins.
 
• Cooking **destroys Vitamin C easily** due to its heat-sensitive nature.
 
• However, cooking does not **destroy Vitamin D easily**. Vitamin D is relatively stable under heat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cooking methods such as boiling, steaming, and frying can affect the nutrient content of food differently.
 
• While some nutrients are lost during cooking, others, such as certain antioxidants, may become more bioavailable.
 
• Balancing raw and cooked foods in the diet can help maximize nutrient intake.
